title: TVS Ntorq 150 Spectral Green Colour Launched
text:
TVS Ntorq 150 Spectral Green Colour Launched - BikeWale 
 Log In AD TVS Ntorq 150 Spectral Green Colour Launched
 Govind Menon November 10, 2026, 09:25 AM IST 18,871 Views Available in the TFT variant
 Features a dark olive finish
 The scooter remains mechanically unchanged
 TVS has added a new colour scheme to the Ntorq 150 , called Spectral Green. This new shade is exclusive to the TFT variant, bringing the total to four shades. It features a dark olive body finish, paired with grey and fluorescent yellow Ntorq 150 graphics.
 Additionally, there are some fluorescent yellow highlights on the fender and the rear section of the body panels. The new shade is quite subtle compared to the other three colours available, and stands out.
 It is ideal for those riders who are looking for something that is understated, but not in black or other muted colours.
 Apart from the addition of the new shade, the scooter remains mechanically unchanged. It continues to be powered by the same 149.7cc single-cylinder, three-valve, air-cooled engine producing 13bhp and 14.2Nm.
 As this shade is only for the TFT variant, it gets the 5-inch TFT console with features such as smartphone connectivity and related features via TVS’ SmartXonnect. The scooter also features two ride modes, a traction control system, and the TVS iGo Assist.
 The Ntorq 150 is priced at Rs. 1,12,900 (ex-showroom) for the standard variant and Rs. 1,22,100 (ex-showroom) for the TFT variant.
